ops-bot: ALERT: P1 - elevated error rate on inference endpoints in us-east-1. Pager triggered for on-call. War room: https://meet.redwood/w/abc123
Leah: I'm on the pager, joining war room in ~30s. Can someone drop a one-liner impact summary for CS?
Sanjay: Seeing spike in 5xxs and tail latency on /v1/generate. Correlates with a KV-cache eviction storm after a short traffic surge. Affected: ~10 orgs, some experiencing timeouts/retries.
Maya: pulling logs + traces now. Adding warroom link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2248
Eli: Quick triage: does this look like runtime eviction (cache thrash) or a serving node OOM cascade?
Sanjay: initial signs point at KV eviction churning hot shards; not OOMs. Working on a targeted cache flush and shard rebalancing.
Leah: I'm primary comms lead. @customer-success-bot please prepare a short status page/blurb we can publish ASAP. Keep it vague on root cause until we confirm.
customer-success-bot: Draft status update ready:

```
We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for text generation in US‑East. Some customers may experience 5xx failures or slow responses. Our engineering team is actively investigating and working on mitigations. Next update in 15 minutes.
```
Maya: quick repro log snippet from one affected worker:

```
2026-08-15T03:00:12Z ERROR inference: model=q4_0 worker=gw-12 req_id=abcd-12345 status=503 kv_evicted=true
```
Eli: Mitigation options (ranked):
1) Toggle routing fallback to a lower-memory model for affected routes (fast, low risk).
2) Spin up additional dedicated worker instances for us‑east (takes ~2–3m).
3) Temporarily relax batching thresholds to reduce KV pressure (medium risk).

Sanjay: I'm taking incident owner. Starting fallback to redwood/llama-13b-quant-v2-fallback on us‑east for tier=standard now. Will monitor error rate.
Leah: I'll publish the status page now. Draft below — edit/approve:

```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Customers in US‑East may see failed requests (5xx) or high latency on text generation endpoints.
Current Mitigation: Routing traffic to a fallback model and increasing capacity where possible.
Next Update: 15 minutes
```
Maya: saving KV stats dump to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1755550000/kv-dump.json. Timeline note: initial spike at ~03:00Z.
Eli: After fallback, watch for error reduction and any downstream cost spikes. If stable for 5m, prepare handoff to infra for postmortem.
Leah: @Sanjay please confirm when errors <1% for 10 minutes and I'll update status to 'identified' and include mitigation detail + CC top customers.
Sanjay: :thumbsup: errors down to 0.85% after fallback. Continuing to monitor.
ops-bot: INFO: auto-update scheduled in 15 minutes. Auto-pager window set to 20 minutes.
Maya: adding graphs to the war room doc: https://docs.redwood/warrooms/1755550000. Capturing heap/disk/eviction metrics now.
Eli: CS/Support: please escalate to the four highest-touch customers listed in the ticket (IDs attached). Use the short template from CS playbook and note 'engineering investigating'.
customer-success-bot: CS notification template prepared and queued for send-on-approval.
incidents-bot: Ticket INF-2248 updated: moved to In Progress (owner: Sanjay).
Leah: Good work. We'll keep war room open until handoff. Owner Sanjay, please paste RCA draft here once you have it and tag for follow-up actions. I'll coordinate customer comms and status page cadence.
Sanjay: Starting live notes in ticket now. Will post preliminary RCA in ~30–45m depending on observed stability.
Leah: moving into voice war room — ping here for any urgent updates.
